svg.title: Rungs 515 and 516 downstream-effect grouping funnel
svg.desc: Most exact attention11 and MLP11 terms are causally active, but none of 17,460 cross-implementation pairs passes both document halves. A diagnostic shows that candidate pairs disappear at the task-effect test before circuit fingerprints can separate them.
svg.text: Active terms do not become reusable downstream variables
Percentages use the complete registered denominator shown under each panel.
Exact term nodes that are measurably active
A term is active only if removing it changes both the task and circuit measurements enough to test.
Cross-implementation pairs passing the full downstream-effect rule
The rule required agreement on two independent document halves, not just similar stored vectors.
task-compatible in both halves: 0.0% (0 / 4,702); circuit attribution therefore had no target population
